San Francisco, CA — June, 3, 2025 — Netlify, the cloud platform for the modern web, today launched its official Netlify Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server, making it easier for AI agents to work alongside developers to build, deploy, and manage production-ready apps on Netlify.
Today we're releasing the Netlify MCP Server. Built on Anthropic's open source Model Context Protocol, our MCP Server gives agents direct access to the Netlify API and CLI.
The Netlify MCP Server acts as a bridge, providing API access, CLI tools, prompts, and more for your agents through the Model Context Protocol.

Netlify MCP Server follows the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable code agents to use the Netlify API and CLI—so they can create new projects, build, deploy, and manage your Netlify resources using natural language prompts.
